calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST;

WITH nl AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(v) AS mine FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) DESC, 1,2
LIMIT 25;

SELECT 'store' k, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) a, store_name b, region c, format d, CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR) f, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) g FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND (open_date IS NOT NULL OR close_date IS NOT NULL OR store_id>=900 OR store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), closure_type, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cnt', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS VARCHAR), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupes', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id||'-'||line_no) AS VARCHAR), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-06-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'retdupes', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM fact_return_line
ORDER BY 1,2;

  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at

ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id

WITH days AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, calendar_date, is_trading_day FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 4
), sd AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 AND net_sales_before_returns>0
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) trading_days, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closed_days,
       MIN(c.n) min_stores, MAX(c.n) max_stores
FROM days d LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) n FROM sd GROUP BY 1) c ON c.business_date=d.calendar_date
GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'detail '||d.calendar_date::VARCHAR, d.is_trading_day::INT, 0, COALESCE(c.n,0), 0 FROM days d LEFT JOIN (SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) n FROM sd GROUP BY 1) c ON c.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE COALESCE(c.n,0) < 38 OR NOT d.is_trading_day
ORDER BY 1;
